intro:
You slowly open your eyes. You are lying on the cold floor of an old **library**. The only door is locked and has a small **4-digit keypad**. Around you, you see a tall **bookshelf**, a wooden **desk** with a **drawer**, a **painting** on the wall and a **grandfather clock**.

Find the clues, solve the puzzles and escape! What do you want to do?

bookshelf.description: A tall bookshelf full of dusty grey books. Three books have bright red spines.

red_books.description: Three red books with Roman numerals on their spines. Inside each one is a handwritten digit: Book I -> 2, Book II -> 5, Book III -> 7.

desk.description: An old wooden desk with a drawer. On the desk lies a sheet of paper that looks completely blank.

paper.description: A sheet of paper that looks completely blank.
paper.secret_text: The clock is exactly one hour slow.

drawer.description: A desk drawer with a 3-digit lock.

painting.description: A portrait of a stern librarian. The golden frame has a tiny keyhole on its side.

uv_flashlight.description: A small UV flashlight. Its purple light can show invisible ink.

clock.description: A tall grandfather clock. It has stopped at 8:25.

door.description: A heavy wooden door with a 4-digit keypad. It is the only way out.
